notes: Native firmware 0.1.36 — the wake lands on the USER'S dashboard: waking from the screensaver navigates to the first dash page (the adopted map's second entry; the contract is [menu, dash..., details]) instead of the stock home with its placeholder buttons. With a delivered design, home AND the menu presses publish only — the manager routes every action against the map it generated (the generated component ids are unknowable to the kit-era constants, and the relays may not exist on home at all: the integration's show_home_relays setting decides). Stock-TFT panels (no map) keep the kit chains. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
